messages.自分で呼吸を貯めながら、クリティカルとパッシブで味方に呼吸を配る剣契のサポーター: A Blade Lineage support and attacker that builds her own Poise and shares it through critical hits and her passive. Allies without Poise receive priority, so surrounding her with allies that use Poise makes the distribution more effective.
messages.配布先の優先順位: S2・S3の配布も、パッシブ「共に吸う息」も、「呼吸がない」: **Distribution priority**: Both the distribution from S2 and S3 and the passive Collective Breathing prioritize allies with no Poise. If the team includes Identities that do not use Poise, the Poise tends to go to them and be wasted.
messages.バトルパッシブ「共に吸う息」(傲慢×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分のスキル・: **Combat passive — Collective Breathing (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time she gains Poise Potency from her own skill or Coin effect, gives 1 Poise to an ally with no Poise or the lowest Poise Potency, up to 3/5 times per turn. S1 Draw of the Sword gains 1 Poise each on Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, so one use gives two chances to trigger it.
messages.S2「剣軌」: Ⅱコインのクリティカル的中時、呼吸がないか呼吸威力が最も少ない味: **S2 — Blade Arc**: On Critical Hit, Coin Ⅱ gives 2 Poise to the 1 ally with no Poise or the lowest Poise Potency, plus 2 more if they are a Blade Lineage member.
messages.S3「さらば！」: 使用時に呼吸5を得る。Ⅲコインのクリティカル的中時、呼吸がな: **S3 — Fare Thee Well!**: Gains 5 Poise on use. On Critical Hit, Coin Ⅲ increases the Poise Count of the 2 allies with no Poise or the lowest Poise Count by 2, plus 2 more for Blade Lineage members. Defeating the target gives herself and 1 random ally 1 Slash DMG Up next turn.
messages.呼吸による自己強化: 自分の呼吸がS1は5以上、S2は7以上、S3は10以上でコ: **Self-buffs from Poise**: +1 Coin Power when her Poise is at least 5 for S1, 7 for S2, and 10 for S3.
messages.呼吸を扱う人格(剣契組織員ならなおよい)で編成を固める。S1・S2を使うたびに自: Fill the team with Identities that use Poise, ideally Blade Lineage members. Build her own Poise each time she uses S1 and S2 while the passive shares it with allies. Once Poise is built up, use S3's Critical Hits to top up allies' Poise Count. The support passive Nightly Stroll (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +1/2 to the Poise Potency gained by the ally with the least Poise, up to 2 times; it does not apply to targets without Poise.
